svg.title: ATLaS-MD NPT volume-move acceptance
svg.desc: Log acceptance equals minus beta times effective-energy and pressure-volume change plus number of molecules times log volume ratio.

text.font-family: Cambria Math, STIX Two Math, Times New Roman, serif
Cambria Math, STIX Two Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: The logarithmic term is the rigid-molecule volume-scaling Jacobian.
